name: Camp Med-O-Lark
description_short: Overnight summer camp in Washington, Maine, with 2-, 4-, 6- and 8-week sessions from late June to late August. Tuition covers housing, three meals a day, snacks and all activities, including the waterfront. Theater options include a musical for 4-week campers and a one-act and cabaret for 2-week campers.
refund_policy_summary: The $1,000 deposit is fully refundable if you change or cancel by March 1, 2027. Tuition paid in full is also refundable until March 1. Half of the remaining tuition is due March 1 and the rest by May 1. Credit card payments have a 3% fee.
swim_waterfront_notes: Tuition includes "Access to All Activities & Waterfront". The page gives no details about swimming or the waterfront.

warnings: Session prices recorded are the regular 2027 rates. Longer sessions already include the multi-session discount (4 weeks drops from $10,400 to $8,400; 6 weeks from $15,600 to $11,600; 8 weeks from $20,800 to $14,800).
Early-enrollment prices are lower if you reserve by Nov 1, 2026, which is about 3 weeks after today: $4,700 for 2 weeks, $7,400 for 4 weeks, $10,100 for 6 weeks and $12,800 for 8 weeks.
Other discounts: $250 off for paying in full in one payment and 10% off for each sibling. Credit cards carry a 3% fee.
The camp says some sessions for some age groups filled up by November last year.
